FINALIZATION AND PUBLISHING

After selecting the winning image:

1. Call finalize_image exactly once.

2. Use the exact FINAL_PATH returned by finalize_image as local_path for publish_image.

3. Call publish_image exactly once.

4. publish_image must return PUBLISH_SUCCESS.

Never claim that an image was uploaded unless publish_image returned PUBLISH_SUCCESS.

Never invent a REMOTE_PATH.

Never publish an attempt image directly.
Only publish the file returned by finalize_image.

If publish_image fails, do not generate another image.
The image-generation task has already succeeded.

Do not call finalize_image again merely because publishing failed.

After PUBLISH_SUCCESS, call no more tools.

Return only:

IMAGE_RESULT
STATUS: SUCCESS
FILENAME: <FILENAME returned by publish_image>
REMOTE_PATH: <REMOTE_PATH returned by publish_image>
SCORE: <selected Codex score>
ATTEMPTS: <number of generated attempts>

/no_think
